summary: Narrative crime-action series spanning the original Lost Heaven story, Definitive Edition remakes/remasters, mobile side games, and the Sicilian prequel.

entries.title: Mafia

primary.why: Mafia: Definitive Edition is a full remake of the 2002 game and is the highest-fidelity modern route; preserve the original PC release only for historical comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mafia: Definitive Edition on Windows with current patch; use the 2002 PC original only for first-version preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Full remake, not a one-to-one replacement for original-version study.

entries.title: Mafia II
entries.definitive_edition: Mafia II: Definitive Edition on Windows

primary.why: The Definitive Edition bundles all DLC and is available on Windows; Windows remains the most configurable route despite remaster caveats.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mafia II: Definitive Edition on Windows with all DLC installed; preserve the original PC release if remaster regressions matter.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remaster may not fully replace original-version study; preserve original PC where possible.

entries.title: Mafia II Mobile

primary.why: The mobile Mafia II side game is a prequel/bridge story rather than a direct adaptation; iOS is selected as the clearer sourced mobile route.
primary.how_to_play: Preserve an old iOS/mobile build if available; document device and app version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern official release is sourced.

entries.title: Mafia III
entries.definitive_edition: Mafia III: Definitive Edition on Windows

primary.why: Mafia III: Definitive Edition bundles the base game and all story DLC; Windows is the most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Mafia III: Definitive Edition on Windows with all DLC installed and patch version noted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document patch version; Definitive Edition bundles story DLC.

entries.title: Mafia III: Rivals

primary.why: Mafia III: Rivals was a mobile RPG tie-in released for Android and iOS; Android is selected as the practical preservation target.
primary.how_to_play: Preserve an installed Android build if available; document app version and account/server state.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern official release is sourced.

primary.why: The Old Country shipped on Windows, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S; Windows is the most flexible high-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release via Steam or another PC storefront with patch/settings documented.
